changelog: 1.2.0 — libellés des sorties en anglais et français (x-i18n). 1.1.0 — chaque champ parle anglais et français (x-i18n : titre, aide, exemple). 1.0.0 — vision par image, transcription et jugement du texte pour le son, règles fermées au worker. Les étapes de modèle échouent PLUTÔT que d'être ignorées : un contrôle de sécurité ne se passe pas d'une réponse.

inputs.prompt: You check one picture before it is shown to someone in a private conversation. Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else, with exactly these three boolean keys: "sexual_or_nudity" (true if it shows nudity or sexual content), "graphic_violence" (true if it shows graphic violence, gore or an injury), "minor_in_unsafe_context" (true if a child or young teenager appears in a sexual, violent or dangerous context). Do not describe the picture. Do not name anyone. If unsure, answer true.

You check the transcript of a voice message before it is played to someone in a private conversation. Answer with ONE JSON object and nothing else, with exactly these three boolean keys: "threat_or_harassment" (true if it threatens, insults or harasses), "sexual_content" (true if it is sexually explicit), "hate" (true if it attacks people for who they are). If unsure, answer true.
